Comment.value: Assassin initiation reagent (roadmap: assassin-quest). Lifted from the quiet knives' dead drop -- the old wine barrel against the houses of Bree (q_asn_drop OnOpen, instance tag AsnDeadDrop) -- only while the PC is in stealth mode (QASN_IsUnseen in q_asn_inc, GetActionMode/ACTION_MODE_STEALTH). GetItemPossessedBy check at Halmir's turn-in (q_asn_c_rdy). Plot + cursed so it cannot be sold, dropped or traded; q_asn_finish clears the plot flag and consumes it. BaseItem 29 + ModelPart1 42 copied from the module's existing Elrond's Writ.

value.0: A single fold of grey paper closed with black wax that bears no sigil -- the quiet knives sign nothing. It was pressed beneath the rim of a wine barrel in Bree and lifted by a hand no eye marked. Whatever name is written inside is not for the carrier to read: Halmir the Grey asked that it come to him sealed, and something about the weight of it suggests he was not making a request.
